tests: R3 the reads: whoami, memberlanguage, the member's own expertiselist, signerlist
R3 the handle drawn fixed in DEC-197's words; no handlechange act, and no handle.changeable, handle.formerly or handle.refused.* drawn

R3, R21 every registry act is drawn (memberlanguageset, setpassword, expertisedeclare, signerregisterown, signerrevokeown, the explanation level, the two sign-outs), and the links to connect and notes
R3 the explanation level: infolevelset sent through the shell's setting, kept on the device (interface-shell R17)
R3, R31 memberlanguageset sends the tag the member chose by name, or null to follow the device; no tag is drawn or typed
R3 setpassword: current and new, the new typed twice alike, sent only when alike (setup-page R3's rule)
R3 expertisedeclare; signerrevokeown for the member's own key
R3 a member without a capability an act needs is not offered it; the founder's session is
R12 account draws the appearance control by cs.appearance(), never the shell's buttons of its own
R21 Sign out on this device (signout) and Sign out everywhere (signouteverywhere), each then drawing front's signed-out state (cs.signedOut, interface-shell R46)
R22 Register your signing key: made by the kit's signer in this browser (cs.signer.register), its public line sent with signerregisterown; no pasted line is asked; declined sends nothing
R57 (1) Make your signing key: the tick, the optional passphrase field (a password field), and the act labelled for the account; the passphrase and the tick are the kit's arguments, the file deferred

R57 (2) after it is made: its tail and day, the public line as data, Copy the public line, and Save the key file only for a key that made a file (never for one kept on the device); nothing of it in any request or storage

R57 (3) a key an administrator registered for the member reads "registered for you by <who>, an administrator, on <date>" with the note that only she can sign with it, beside Revoke; one she made herself is drawn as before
R42 account draws the Sounds choice (off by default) beside Language and Appearance, and sends nothing when it is changed; no sentence is drawn twice
R57 (1), (2) a key made with a typed passphrase opens no dialog, sends keyB64, and offers Save the key file from page memory; the passphrase and the file are in no request or storage
R67 Your cover name: the cover and handle said, the stored choice the only one preselected, and memberpairingset sends memberId and published; the state is read back
R67 control: a member the pairings do not hold (the founder, who has no cover) is drawn no such section; a failed read is drawn failed, never as a choice

R22 R57 C51: the key section offers the member's key file, and a file chosen is read by the kit, handed to the signer (the dialog asks only the passphrase) and the key it holds is the one registered; nothing of the file is stored or sent

R22 R57 C51: an unreadable or empty key file is refused in the kit's word (the dialog's own, while the list lacks it) before anything is asked of the device; no file chosen makes the key as before (control)

tests: R65 bias lists exactly its registry acts (the red contract test holds it), and nothing is sent by drawing it beyond the lens and the projects
R65 the lens in force for the whole team: each statement's kind, subject, text and reason, who adopted and when, what the set does not enforce, and the lens's number; no empty lens

R65 choosing a project and asking for its lens sends scope and scopeId and draws the team's statements then the project's; a project with nothing in force says so and what a case published now says, never an empty lens
R65 the folds: a project statement that met a locked one, and a set adopted while only offered, each only when the owner says so

R65 writing a set: the bundle promote takes (a bias bundle offered), the subject resolved from its name, the guard accepts it; a name the record does not know is refused in place; then the saved set can be adopted for the team or a project with the member's reason

R65 the team's earlier offered sets are listed and adoptable without writing them again: the cursor is followed, the set just saved comes first, a set of another type or already adopted is not listed, an empty answer draws no list
R65 a refusal is drawn by the owner's words beside the act, and nothing else changes; a set with no name or no reason is not sent

R65 drafting from an outside policy: biasinhale sends the policy, where it comes from and when; the proposals are marked not yet the member's, a bar and a verdict are left out with the design's words; nothing is saved until she starts a set, which promotes a draft once each has a subject and a reason

R65 work made under an earlier lens: the address names the work, its record is read, a member settles it with her own reason (1 to 4,000 characters), the assistant cannot; a settled one shows its settlement and offers no settling; unknown work draws nothing
R65 control: a request that carries a field its owner does not declare is refused by the guard (promote's, biasadopt's, biasinhale's and biasdebtresolve's bodies are accepted)
R65 C87: Propose statements from it with the policy empty, and Save the set with a required box empty, send nothing and name the box; filled, they send (control)
R65 C94: who adopted a set and who settled a debt are named by memberName: the handle where it differs from the id, the fallback word where the member has none, never an id
R8 every act of every screen, once answered, reads again what it changes and draws it
R8 nothing is drawn as done before the answer: while an act has not answered, the screen is unchanged
R10 no key, code or password typed is kept in the browser's storage, put in an address, sent in a later request, or drawn again
R28 every element every screen draws uses a class a served stylesheet defines; a section holds something; control: a read that failed is still drawn failed
R28 every labeled field is drawn with cs.field: its label and its help are boxes of their own, tied by aria-describedby; a field has no bare label with a help beside it
R27 R73 C94: updates names who allowed or skipped a release by memberName: the handle where it differs from the id, the fallback word where the member has none, never an id
R48 C94: teamai names who set the key, and who made each change, by memberName; a member with no handle by the fallback word, never an id
R57 C94: a key an administrator registered for the member names the registrar by memberName: the handle where it differs from the id, the fallback word for one with none, never an id
R15 C94: a member who does not administer is told whose screen security is by the administrators' handles; an administrator with none by the fallback word, never an id
R3 the reads: whoami, memberlanguage, the member's own expertiselist, signerlist
R3 the handle drawn fixed in DEC-197's words; no handlechange act, and no handle.changeable, handle.formerly or handle.refused.* drawn

R3, R21 every registry act is drawn (memberlanguageset, setpassword, expertisedeclare, signerregisterown, signerrevokeown, the explanation level, the two sign-outs), and the links to connect and notes
R3 the explanation level: infolevelset sent through the shell's setting, kept on the device (interface-shell R17)
R3, R31 memberlanguageset sends the tag the member chose by name, or null to follow the device; no tag is drawn or typed
R3 setpassword: current and new, the new typed twice alike, sent only when alike (setup-page R3's rule)
R3 expertisedeclare; signerrevokeown for the member's own key
R3 a member without a capability an act needs is not offered it; the founder's session is
R12 account draws the appearance control by cs.appearance(), never the shell's buttons of its own
R21 Sign out on this device (signout) and Sign out everywhere (signouteverywhere), each then drawing front's signed-out state (cs.signedOut, interface-shell R46)
R22 Register your signing key: made by the kit's signer in this browser (cs.signer.register), its public line sent with signerregisterown; no pasted line is asked; declined sends nothing
R57 (1) Make your signing key: the tick, the optional passphrase field (a password field), and the act labelled for the account; the passphrase and the tick are the kit's arguments, the file deferred

R57 (2) after it is made: its tail and day, the public line as data, Copy the public line, and Save the key file only for a key that made a file (never for one kept on the device); nothing of it in any request or storage

R57 (3) a key an administrator registered for the member reads "registered for you by <who>, an administrator, on <date>" with the note that only she can sign with it, beside Revoke; one she made herself is drawn as before
R42 account draws the Sounds choice (off by default) beside Language and Appearance, and sends nothing when it is changed; no sentence is drawn twice
R57 (1), (2) a key made with a typed passphrase opens no dialog, sends keyB64, and offers Save the key file from page memory; the passphrase and the file are in no request or storage
R67 Your cover name: the cover and handle said, the stored choice the only one preselected, and memberpairingset sends memberId and published; the state is read back
R67 control: a member the pairings do not hold (the founder, who has no cover) is drawn no such section; a failed read is drawn failed, never as a choice

R22 R57 C51: the key section offers the member's key file, and a file chosen is read by the kit, handed to the signer (the dialog asks only the passphrase) and the key it holds is the one registered; nothing of the file is stored or sent

R22 R57 C51: an unreadable or empty key file is refused in the kit's word (the dialog's own, while the list lacks it) before anything is asked of the device; no file chosen makes the key as before (control)
R17 settings: "Yours" then, to a session that administers, "The group's", each a reference to its screen; a member is drawn only their own
R32 settings draws its sections as the design's link list: each its icon and its screen's name as the reference, its purpose beneath, the two never run together
R20 recovery: the member's own codes (recoverycodesstate); new codes shown once, saying first that issuing again spends the earlier ones
R20 recovery: to an administrator, adminrecoverystep's note while not met; nothing once met, and a step that did not answer is never drawn as not met
R42 recovery draws screen.recovery.onlyyou once, above the act that issues new codes

R17 C91: the doors to the watched addresses and the leads are drawn from Settings to an administrator and to a member who may use them, under 'For every member'; a session that may not write a lead is drawn no door to the leads (control)
R17 C87 (d): Settings holds a door to the team's own rules, under 'For every member', to an administrator and to a member; every screen the list names is named once (control)
every text drawn by every screen, in every state, is a word or the record's data; every key drawn is listed in the screen's words
control: a text written into a render, not a word, is found

R27 an administrator who holds the hosting account: what runs now, the release ready with its security mark, signature and three-part notes, Update and Not now, Skip under a disclosure, the earlier releases
R27 a release without a security fix carries no mark; the notes' last part only when not empty
R27 nothing ready: updates.none, no Update, Not now or Skip; the running release and the earlier ones still drawn
R27 an administrator who does not hold the hosting account: no Update but the hand-off, the link to copy being the address updatestart answers
R27 Update: on its answer the installer's address is offered in a new browsing context, with no opener and no referrer
R27 R34 Not now sends the version; Skip this version is reasoned: its reason, one line, is sent; none sends nothing

R27 controls: a note carrying <script> is drawn as text, never markup; a member who does not administer reads nothing and is told the screen is administrators'; a failed read is drawn failed, never as nothing to install
R37 who allowed or skipped a release is a handle when a member did it; an install with no member behind it is drawn without one; the founder by her handle in her own session

R81 (R73) the set-up release is updatenotice's setup, never bootstrap's installed_at: a copy set up on one release and running a later one says the running release with no member is noactor and the set-up date is the set-up release's day, said once; a release with a member is unchanged (control); no setup held claims nothing about setup (control)
R68 How your copy is doing: the check (selftest) draws what it found from its answer; a problem is drawn in its fold; the optional part is said not set up
R68 What each part runs (bootstrap with members): each part named as the answer names it with its release; a silent part is said silent; the others show their state; a failed answer is drawn failed
R68 What running costs (runtime): the measured work as the answer gives it, the two limits explained, and the note; a failed answer is drawn failed
R68 units (DEC-389): a runtime figure is said with its unit by key (unit.ms, unit.bytes); a unit with no key is never drawn as its raw token
R68 control: the section is an administrator's only; a member reads that the screen is administrators' and none of the three reads is sent

R61 reads the rules and the roster; Waiting for a second member lists each drafted rule: what it is for, who drafted it and when, its source as a reference opening the document, its trigger, citation and the day it takes effect
R61 a rule the viewer drafted is told so and has no confirm act; every other waiting rule has one (R61: Drafted by you)
R61 Confirm this rule: a tier 1 rule asks no statement; a tier 2, 3 or unknown tier asks the confirmer's own, required before the act is sent, kept with the confirmation alone
R61 Rules in force: each confirmed rule with who drafted and confirmed it and that it applies, and Withdraw this rule, with a reason (rulewithdraw); a rule not yet in effect is not said to apply
R61 control: the assistant's note is drawn; a failed read is drawn failed, never as no rules; a read with no rules draws no section

R61 the draft form draws the design's fields: the kinds of action by their own names (claim first), the choices by their words, the document among the captures held, and writing help only while the assistant is reachable and only under What it says
R61 ruledraft for a deadline sends the section, the entry built from the fields (the stored rule derived from the one name), the source with the passage's place, and the reason
R61 ruledraft for a legal fact sends the key derived from the name, the trigger, what it says and the kinds ticked; none ticked leaves applies_to out
R61 a passage that is not in the document as written sends nothing and says so; a rule with no source held, no name or no whole amount sends nothing
R61 writinghelp under What it says fills the draft into that field, labelled the assistant's, kept only by the member's own ruledraft; it asks for no draft of an empty field

R70 the 'Which document' picker is read with state held_and_vouched: with one held and one vouched document it offers both, and a vouched one is chosen and drafted from; asked without that state it would list only the held (control)
R70 C14: the picker is read once when the screen opens, by the cheap picker read (fields picker), and no act reads the whole list again; the picker rows are the cheap ones
R70 G20: with 250 documents held the picker reaches the 250th, reading on by the cursor, and a draft names it; control: 150 documents are read once and nothing is said of more
R70 G20: past the bound it keeps (the first page and two more) the picker says how many it shows and a search narrows by title; control: the search reads nothing more
R70 G20: a page the cursor names that cannot be read leaves the first page offered and says it is the first rows shown, never a picker that looks whole
R61 C87: Draft the rule with a required box empty sends nothing and names the box; filled, it sends (control)

R61 C94: a rule's drafter and confirmer are named by memberName: a member with no handle by the fallback word, a member the roster does not hold by it too, the founder by hers or the unnamed word, never an id; a member with a handle by it (control)
R15 security: an administrator's screen; any other member is told only that it is administrators', and nothing is read
R15 the level for the period chosen, by kind against its usual, naming no address, country, role or member
R15 what is built in is said only as part_scanner and part_safe_view answer it
R15 securitytooladd asks only the entry's config by its labels, its credentials in the body only, confirms the vendor's keeping, sends the handling's digest; then tests it and says whether it is on
R15 securitytooltest and securitytoolremove from the tool's row panel; a refusal in file-safety's words
R62 security reads whose server from data: handling.on_own, never the recipient's words
R43 an ordinary period leads with one sentence under its mark, the period named by its first and last day, the counts folded, and the catalogue of kinds only in the 'Add another checker' fold
R43 a raised or high period leads with what happened (a hard try at signing in) and that it was refused
R43 a period may end today: to is no later than the end of the present hour; the opening period asked again lands; a period ending yesterday sends the next midnight as before
R43 a start after the end sends nothing and draws the refusal in a fold, open, that is drawn only then; a member who does not administer reads only that the screen is administrators'
R15 a tool in use is named by its provider's display name (vendor and product from the catalogue), never by its slug

R74 each credential field of a provider is labelled by its word (file-scanner.credential.<field>), never its raw name; the field sent stays the catalogue's; a field outside the four keeps its own name
R77 a scanner that holds no signatures is said so by the keys scanstatus answers, with the day and the reason; absent, nothing is drawn (control)

R15, R77 C83: files are said to be checked only while signatures are held; a scanner with none draws that state with its date and reason and no checked sentence; control: signatures held draw the sentence
R15, R77 C83: the administrator's step is said once in each state of a scanner with no signatures; where no reason line is drawn it is drawn on its own; the other states draw none (control)
R15 C84: Security draws a button that checks for new signatures now, sends scanmirror once, draws that the run goes on, and reads the scanner's state again

R15 C84: a run asked for inside the minimum gap, or with no scanner bound, is refused beside the button in file-safety's own words; no button where no scanner is built in, and none to a member who does not administer (control)
R1 the reads: the roster for every member; the recovery step and the signing keys for an administrator; a member's expertise when opened; nothing of the team's key (R47)
R1 the roster: each member's handle, cover (to an administrator), role, capabilities and status; no "formerly" (DEC-197)
R47 to a member who does not administer, Members is a table of members, what each may do and their expertise, with who changes it; no key or keep-away section
R1 the one-administrator note while the step is not met, as setup-page R16 states it; nothing once met
R1 each read drawn in its state: still loading, empty, could not read (never as empty), or its data
R2 every registry act is drawn for an administrator where it applies, each row's acts in its own panel; none to a member who does not administer
R2 memberadd: the short id, the cover and the capabilities ticked; the invitation answered shown once, with the sentence that no email is sent
R2 the row acts send their owners' arguments: membercaps, memberset, adminendorse, adminremove (with its reason), expertiseconfirm, invitewithdraw
R2 joining through the website: websitekeycreate and joinlinkenable with a daily cap; the key and the link shown once
R2 a refusal is drawn beside its act and nothing else changes; R8 nothing is drawn as done before the answer
R12 each row's name is the member's reference (cs.ref member, opening members/<id>), its panel opened by its own control
R23 a member's row offers Make a reset link (passwordresetlink), the link shown once with the sentence that no email is sent
R23 More for administrators links group, places and recovery; a member's row offers no signing-key act of its own (R55 draws them in the keys section)
R55 the keys section lists a row for each active member and the founder: who registered each active key and when, the founder named as R51 names her, and no key says so
R55 Withdraw is offered on another member's active key and never on the viewer's own (she revokes it on account); it sends signerset revoked for that key
R55 a withdrawn key reads who withdrew it and when, that it does not sign, and offers Reactivate: signerset active; never for a member who has left
R55 a registered_by or status_by of `not recorded`, or a null status_at, is never drawn as a person or a day: the unrecorded lines
R55 Register a key for this member (signeradd): the pasted line is split into keyB64 and comment, with memberId; a line not of that shape, a private key or an empty line sends nothing
R55 control: a member who does not administer is drawn none of it and reads no signerlist; a failed read is drawn failed, never as no keys
R56 with adminarith answering the live row for 4 administrators the sentence carries 3 and 4; at 3 and above it says how many votes it takes
R56 control: one administrator reads that none can be removed by vote; a roster that lists every counted administrator draws no reconcile fold; more counted than listed draws it with the difference
R29 Administrators and Active members count the roster as listed, the founder's row once among them (R51)
R29 control: a member with no expertise shows no Expertise, and an empty cell draws nothing
R35, R51 a claimed team with no founder handle held draws her row from the roster, handle null: Active members 2, Administrators 1 with one other member; never named by admin
R35 control: with her handle held her row draws it, in her own session and wherever the roster answers it
R56 the scale table: a row for each count of administrators from adminarith's table, the live row marked (now) and aria-current; one administrator reads not removable

R56 a removal under way is drawn from adminremovalsopen alone: who it waits for, how many of those who may vote have agreed, the one facing removal counted and not voting; none under way draws no block; a failed read is drawn failed
R63 a confirmed expertise offers Withdraw an expertise, its own act: expertisewithdraw sends memberId, label and the reason; an unconfirmed one still offers Confirm and no withdrawal (control)
R63 control: no withdrawal for an expertise already withdrawn, nor to a member who does not administer
R64 the signing-key chooser lists the founder, first, once the instance is claimed and she holds a handle; a roster without her row, or her with none, is unchanged (control)
R71 a member's name is a reference to their handle, not to the id they were invited under; opening that address opens that member's row

R72 choosing the grant that includes administering draws the confirmation and sends nothing; Go back sends nothing and unticks it; Make them an administrator sends the declared fields; a grant without administering sends at once (control)

R2 C89: inviting a third administrator is a proposal the plane records: it is drawn as done (not as a refusal) with who must still endorse, the roster is read again and shows the proposed member; control: another refusal is still a refusal, and an invitation that is not for an administrator is unchanged

R2 C89: endorsing a proposed administrator while others must still endorse is done, with who must still endorse by handle, and the roster is read again; control: a real refusal of the act is still a refusal
R56 C90: the vote to remove an administrator is not drawn where the plane cannot carry it (two administrators); with three, or with the count unread, it is (control)
R55 R56 C94: a key's registrar and a removal's voters are named by memberName: a member the roster does not hold or who has no handle by the fallback word, never an id
R16 translations: the group's languages each open their words; translations and interfacewords read for the chosen language
R16 each word a row: its English, meaning note, state, its text with who adopted it, and whether its English changed
R16 the panel: translationadopt (typed, or a stored draft kept as drafted), translationconfirm (an awaiting protected word), translationrevert (an administrator's)

R16 translationdraft: the picked words' drafts and an administrator's reading of an awaiting protected word go to the door while the assistant is reachable; the door's refusal is drawn in its words, and nothing is drafted, adopted or confirmed
R16 translationgrant: an administrator grants or revokes a named member's right for the language
R31 translations: every language is listed by its name in the member's language and never as a tag; the group's source English is not offered; a row shows its English and meaning, never its key
R31 translations: a member who is not granted sees the refusal's own words alone, no section about the words
R37 a group with no language beside English draws screens-settings' languages.none by key; no language is offered, nor a choice of one; a failed read is drawn failed

outside.waitsOn: this module
tests: R8 every act of every screen, once answered, reads again what it changes and draws it
R8 nothing is drawn as done before the answer: while an act has not answered, the screen is unchanged
R10 no key, code or password typed is kept in the browser's storage, put in an address, sent in a later request, or drawn again
R28 every element every screen draws uses a class a served stylesheet defines; a section holds something; control: a read that failed is still drawn failed

R48 C94: teamai names who set the key, and who made each change, by memberName; a member with no handle by the fallback word, never an id
R57 C94: a key an administrator registered for the member names the registrar by memberName: the handle where it differs from the id, the fallback word for one with none, never an id

R3 the reads: whoami, memberlanguage, the member's own expertiselist, signerlist
R3 the handle drawn fixed in DEC-197's words; no handlechange act, and no handle.changeable, handle.formerly or handle.refused.* drawn

R3, R21 every registry act is drawn (memberlanguageset, setpassword, expertisedeclare, signerregisterown, signerrevokeown, the explanation level, the two sign-outs), and the links to connect and notes
R3 the explanation level: infolevelset sent through the shell's setting, kept on the device (interface-shell R17)
R3, R31 memberlanguageset sends the tag the member chose by name, or null to follow the device; no tag is drawn or typed
R3 setpassword: current and new, the new typed twice alike, sent only when alike (setup-page R3's rule)
R3 expertisedeclare; signerrevokeown for the member's own key
R3 a member without a capability an act needs is not offered it; the founder's session is
R12 account draws the appearance control by cs.appearance(), never the shell's buttons of its own
R21 Sign out on this device (signout) and Sign out everywhere (signouteverywhere), each then drawing front's signed-out state (cs.signedOut, interface-shell R46)
R22 Register your signing key: made by the kit's signer in this browser (cs.signer.register), its public line sent with signerregisterown; no pasted line is asked; declined sends nothing
R57 (1) Make your signing key: the tick, the optional passphrase field (a password field), and the act labelled for the account; the passphrase and the tick are the kit's arguments, the file deferred

R57 (2) after it is made: its tail and day, the public line as data, Copy the public line, and Save the key file only for a key that made a file (never for one kept on the device); nothing of it in any request or storage

R57 (3) a key an administrator registered for the member reads "registered for you by <who>, an administrator, on <date>" with the note that only she can sign with it, beside Revoke; one she made herself is drawn as before
R42 account draws the Sounds choice (off by default) beside Language and Appearance, and sends nothing when it is changed; no sentence is drawn twice
R57 (1), (2) a key made with a typed passphrase opens no dialog, sends keyB64, and offers Save the key file from page memory; the passphrase and the file are in no request or storage
R67 Your cover name: the cover and handle said, the stored choice the only one preselected, and memberpairingset sends memberId and published; the state is read back
R67 control: a member the pairings do not hold (the founder, who has no cover) is drawn no such section; a failed read is drawn failed, never as a choice

R22 R57 C51: the key section offers the member's key file, and a file chosen is read by the kit, handed to the signer (the dialog asks only the passphrase) and the key it holds is the one registered; nothing of the file is stored or sent

R22 R57 C51: an unreadable or empty key file is refused in the kit's word (the dialog's own, while the list lacks it) before anything is asked of the device; no file chosen makes the key as before (control)
R17 settings: "Yours" then, to a session that administers, "The group's", each a reference to its screen; a member is drawn only their own
R32 settings draws its sections as the design's link list: each its icon and its screen's name as the reference, its purpose beneath, the two never run together
R20 recovery: the member's own codes (recoverycodesstate); new codes shown once, saying first that issuing again spends the earlier ones
R20 recovery: to an administrator, adminrecoverystep's note while not met; nothing once met, and a step that did not answer is never drawn as not met
R42 recovery draws screen.recovery.onlyyou once, above the act that issues new codes

R17 C91: the doors to the watched addresses and the leads are drawn from Settings to an administrator and to a member who may use them, under 'For every member'; a session that may not write a lead is drawn no door to the leads (control)
R17 C87 (d): Settings holds a door to the team's own rules, under 'For every member', to an administrator and to a member; every screen the list names is named once (control)
every text drawn by every screen, in every state, is a word or the record's data; every key drawn is listed in the screen's words
control: a text written into a render, not a word, is found

R27 an administrator who holds the hosting account: what runs now, the release ready with its security mark, signature and three-part notes, Update and Not now, Skip under a disclosure, the earlier releases
R27 a release without a security fix carries no mark; the notes' last part only when not empty
R27 nothing ready: updates.none, no Update, Not now or Skip; the running release and the earlier ones still drawn
R27 an administrator who does not hold the hosting account: no Update but the hand-off, the link to copy being the address updatestart answers
R27 Update: on its answer the installer's address is offered in a new browsing context, with no opener and no referrer
R27 R34 Not now sends the version; Skip this version is reasoned: its reason, one line, is sent; none sends nothing

R27 controls: a note carrying <script> is drawn as text, never markup; a member who does not administer reads nothing and is told the screen is administrators'; a failed read is drawn failed, never as nothing to install
R37 who allowed or skipped a release is a handle when a member did it; an install with no member behind it is drawn without one; the founder by her handle in her own session

R81 (R73) the set-up release is updatenotice's setup, never bootstrap's installed_at: a copy set up on one release and running a later one says the running release with no member is noactor and the set-up date is the set-up release's day, said once; a release with a member is unchanged (control); no setup held claims nothing about setup (control)
R68 How your copy is doing: the check (selftest) draws what it found from its answer; a problem is drawn in its fold; the optional part is said not set up
R68 What each part runs (bootstrap with members): each part named as the answer names it with its release; a silent part is said silent; the others show their state; a failed answer is drawn failed
R68 What running costs (runtime): the measured work as the answer gives it, the two limits explained, and the note; a failed answer is drawn failed
R68 units (DEC-389): a runtime figure is said with its unit by key (unit.ms, unit.bytes); a unit with no key is never drawn as its raw token
R68 control: the section is an administrator's only; a member reads that the screen is administrators' and none of the three reads is sent

tests: R3 the reads: whoami, memberlanguage, the member's own expertiselist, signerlist
R3 the handle drawn fixed in DEC-197's words; no handlechange act, and no handle.changeable, handle.formerly or handle.refused.* drawn

R3, R21 every registry act is drawn (memberlanguageset, setpassword, expertisedeclare, signerregisterown, signerrevokeown, the explanation level, the two sign-outs), and the links to connect and notes
R3 the explanation level: infolevelset sent through the shell's setting, kept on the device (interface-shell R17)
R3, R31 memberlanguageset sends the tag the member chose by name, or null to follow the device; no tag is drawn or typed
R3 setpassword: current and new, the new typed twice alike, sent only when alike (setup-page R3's rule)
R3 expertisedeclare; signerrevokeown for the member's own key
R3 a member without a capability an act needs is not offered it; the founder's session is
R12 account draws the appearance control by cs.appearance(), never the shell's buttons of its own
R21 Sign out on this device (signout) and Sign out everywhere (signouteverywhere), each then drawing front's signed-out state (cs.signedOut, interface-shell R46)
R22 Register your signing key: made by the kit's signer in this browser (cs.signer.register), its public line sent with signerregisterown; no pasted line is asked; declined sends nothing
R57 (1) Make your signing key: the tick, the optional passphrase field (a password field), and the act labelled for the account; the passphrase and the tick are the kit's arguments, the file deferred

R57 (2) after it is made: its tail and day, the public line as data, Copy the public line, and Save the key file only for a key that made a file (never for one kept on the device); nothing of it in any request or storage

R57 (3) a key an administrator registered for the member reads "registered for you by <who>, an administrator, on <date>" with the note that only she can sign with it, beside Revoke; one she made herself is drawn as before
R42 account draws the Sounds choice (off by default) beside Language and Appearance, and sends nothing when it is changed; no sentence is drawn twice
R57 (1), (2) a key made with a typed passphrase opens no dialog, sends keyB64, and offers Save the key file from page memory; the passphrase and the file are in no request or storage
R67 Your cover name: the cover and handle said, the stored choice the only one preselected, and memberpairingset sends memberId and published; the state is read back
R67 control: a member the pairings do not hold (the founder, who has no cover) is drawn no such section; a failed read is drawn failed, never as a choice

R22 R57 C51: the key section offers the member's key file, and a file chosen is read by the kit, handed to the signer (the dialog asks only the passphrase) and the key it holds is the one registered; nothing of the file is stored or sent

R22 R57 C51: an unreadable or empty key file is refused in the kit's word (the dialog's own, while the list lacks it) before anything is asked of the device; no file chosen makes the key as before (control)
R65 bias lists exactly its registry acts (the red contract test holds it), and nothing is sent by drawing it beyond the lens and the projects
R65 the lens in force for the whole team: each statement's kind, subject, text and reason, who adopted and when, what the set does not enforce, and the lens's number; no empty lens

R65 choosing a project and asking for its lens sends scope and scopeId and draws the team's statements then the project's; a project with nothing in force says so and what a case published now says, never an empty lens
R65 the folds: a project statement that met a locked one, and a set adopted while only offered, each only when the owner says so

R65 writing a set: the bundle promote takes (a bias bundle offered), the subject resolved from its name, the guard accepts it; a name the record does not know is refused in place; then the saved set can be adopted for the team or a project with the member's reason

R65 the team's earlier offered sets are listed and adoptable without writing them again: the cursor is followed, the set just saved comes first, a set of another type or already adopted is not listed, an empty answer draws no list
R65 a refusal is drawn by the owner's words beside the act, and nothing else changes; a set with no name or no reason is not sent

R65 drafting from an outside policy: biasinhale sends the policy, where it comes from and when; the proposals are marked not yet the member's, a bar and a verdict are left out with the design's words; nothing is saved until she starts a set, which promotes a draft once each has a subject and a reason

R65 work made under an earlier lens: the address names the work, its record is read, a member settles it with her own reason (1 to 4,000 characters), the assistant cannot; a settled one shows its settlement and offers no settling; unknown work draws nothing
R65 control: a request that carries a field its owner does not declare is refused by the guard (promote's, biasadopt's, biasinhale's and biasdebtresolve's bodies are accepted)
R65 C87: Propose statements from it with the policy empty, and Save the set with a required box empty, send nothing and name the box; filled, they send (control)
R65 C94: who adopted a set and who settled a debt are named by memberName: the handle where it differs from the id, the fallback word where the member has none, never an id
R8 every act of every screen, once answered, reads again what it changes and draws it
R8 nothing is drawn as done before the answer: while an act has not answered, the screen is unchanged
R10 no key, code or password typed is kept in the browser's storage, put in an address, sent in a later request, or drawn again
R28 every element every screen draws uses a class a served stylesheet defines; a section holds something; control: a read that failed is still drawn failed
R28 every labeled field is drawn with cs.field: its label and its help are boxes of their own, tied by aria-describedby; a field has no bare label with a help beside it
R27 R73 C94: updates names who allowed or skipped a release by memberName: the handle where it differs from the id, the fallback word where the member has none, never an id
R48 C94: teamai names who set the key, and who made each change, by memberName; a member with no handle by the fallback word, never an id
R57 C94: a key an administrator registered for the member names the registrar by memberName: the handle where it differs from the id, the fallback word for one with none, never an id
R15 C94: a member who does not administer is told whose screen security is by the administrators' handles; an administrator with none by the fallback word, never an id
R4 the reads: assistantstate, aikeepawaystate, groupkeystate, groupkeynotice, disclosureof, accountreference, subscriptionsignin {step: state}, and the member's own account (owner member:<me>)
R4 exactly one of four situations: the group's key serves (with the member's daily allowance), the member's own account, nothing yet, or the group keeps its material away
R4 a keep-away that could not be read is not taken as off: the assistant is drawn kept away, with no act (instance-setup R53)
R5 the two notices, each outward, before the first question: groupkeynoticeseen on the group's key, disclosureshown before connecting one's own
R4, R5, R13 connecting, in DEC-156's order: the subscription (only while bootstrap's part_signin answers true), then an API key, then not now
R30 while nothing serves the member, one choice is asked first (My Claude subscription, An API key, Not now), the subscription preselected, and only the chosen path's steps are drawn
R5 the subscription sign-in: start, the address offered in a new browsing context (noopener noreferrer), then the code in the body only; connected draws the member's own account
R5, R24 every subscriptionsignin refusal is drawn in words (refusal.<code> where words.json holds it, else this module's), {detail} filled, never the typed code; nothing else changes
R24 a refusal's reference is drawn beside its words (interface-shell R39) and kept nowhere in the browser
R24 Open Anthropic's sign-in page is disabled while a start is in flight, and pressable again once it answers or is refused

R24 the state as the plane holds it: connected since when and until when; a failed state read is said, never not connected; refused at Anthropic draws connect again once; the code field says to copy the whole code
R5, R76 an API key: accountreferenceset with the key in the body only, and no member (the door stamps whose it is, ai-accounts R35), never drawn again
R5, R76 the key the page sends is held by the team's record for the member who sent it: the reference is read again and draws her own account
R5 disconnect: a subscription by subscriptiondisconnect, an API key by accountreferenceremove; R9 the member's own account in its parts
R5, R76 the key the page removes is removed from the team's record, and the reference is read again
R5 the group's key serving a member: no settings of the group's account are offered, and no account panel
R37 the group's key: the allowance and the limits are drawn with their fills; what was used and the suggestions only when answered, never with an empty one
R37 the member's own account: the day it was signed in, else nothing invented; the changes name the member by handle, never "you"
R38 beside the code: the sign-in's refusals by their keys under connect.ifnot, each with its reference (refusal.reference); the typed code is never drawn
R30 R36 (K3347) connect gains no pointer to the group key and no API-key preselection; the subscription stays preselected; reauth sends the password, none sends nothing
R49 the team's key serves her: the optional line, one card, then the notice (needed first, open), her allowance, her use and connecting her own (closed); her share as a meter
R49 her own API key serves her: the card, then what the assistant may do (checkboxes: everyday apart from without being asked), a limit with its words, her use and Disconnect
R49 her subscription serves her: the card with the connected tag and the day Anthropic stops accepting the sign-in; a limit only in tokens or calls; Disconnect
R49 a team that does not pay (nothing serves her yet) and a team keeping its material away: before you connect (needed first), connect; or one card and no act
R50 a code being exchanged: working is said beside the button, which is not pressed again; the code is sent once
R50 the refusal of the exchange is the outcome drawn, the page is no longer working, and the button can be pressed again
R54 a sign-in that has expired draws its date, what it means, the state and what to do, and the act to sign in again once; the connected tag is gone
the screens are the registry's, each listing exactly its registry acts, an owed act by the op it owes (interface-shell R38)
every act names an op OPS holds (owed:infolevelset's op among them, op-declarations R50), and every read too
the shell serves the screens: interfacePage passes its R21 check, and the page runs each screen from its own source (self-contained), drawing it
R39 words by key: the module holds no row, every key it reads is a word of the list (hasWord), the design's reads list is met and its retired row is gone
R39 what a screen draws for a sample of its keys equals word(key, vars)
R59 the glossary draws the title and its sub-line, how a term explains itself, two groups of terms each with its name and its definition, the states and the note about a document's own terms
R59 what each state allows: one row for each of the sixteen item states, its chip or name, what it means, and what a member can and cannot then do where the words hold it
R59 control: it reads nothing and calls no op, draws no act, and is registered in the module's screens
R18 group: what the group chose is drawn to every member; the acts only to an administrator (control: a member is drawn none)
R18 group: groupnameset, groupdomainset, grouplanguagesset, courtnoticeset, hostingaccessset and strengthbarset (reasoned) send their owners' arguments
R18 group: grouplogoset sends the chosen PNG or JPEG's own bytes as the body with its type, nothing in the address; another type sends nothing
R31 group: every language is shown by its name in the member's language and ticked by name; a tag such as en-US is never shown or typed
R33, R75 group: a hosting account recorded at setup or by the system is set at setup or by the system (its own words), never a credential's name
R28 group: a section that holds nothing is not drawn, and nothing says there is none
R40 the statement is drawn with who set it and when, or that none is declared; a member reads it and is drawn no act
R40 declaredstakeset saves the statement; an emptied field clears it (null); STAKE_MALFORMED and NOT_AN_ADMIN are drawn by their words
R40 writinghelp under the field only while the assistant is reachable; its draft in the field, labeled, untested where the answer says so, kept only by the administrator's own save
R44 group: the hosting account and the bar carry their card on the heading; each section opens with its sentence; the card is not said again in the body
R45 the zone that governs is shown by its name, never its id: the design's seven by label.timezones.*, any other by its generic name and its city
R45 a correction sends factconfirm with act correct, the zone, how and source on the team's own path (a place's zone is only the default); then the zone is read again and named as saved
R45 none held: a fold, the choice below it, no UTC; a member who does not administer is drawn no correction
R45 D-B1 no place chosen: the zone is stated from the screen on the team's own path, the owner takes it, and the screen then names it as the team's
R52 a value not set by a member is said as set at setup or by the system, never by a credential's name; a value set by a member is not
R52 after groupnameset answers, the new name is said (screen.group.name.saved); the same name says nothing changed, in a fold open whenever drawn

R66 the founder is drawn the copy of the record (a field for her words, Take a copy of the record, that it cannot be undone) and the list of copies; the list shows each copy's time, its counts and her words, newest first

R69 control: an answer with no file draws the steps without one; no claim draws no fold; a member reads the file as well, and is offered no act; groupdomainset refused draws the design's words
R75 the hosting account recorded at setup or by Civicsmith itself says so, in its own words; one a member recorded keeps today's (control)

R1 the roster: each member's handle, cover (to an administrator), role, capabilities and status; no "formerly" (DEC-197)
R47 to a member who does not administer, Members is a table of members, what each may do and their expertise, with who changes it; no key or keep-away section
R1 the one-administrator note while the step is not met, as setup-page R16 states it; nothing once met
R1 each read drawn in its state: still loading, empty, could not read (never as empty), or its data
R2 every registry act is drawn for an administrator where it applies, each row's acts in its own panel; none to a member who does not administer
R2 memberadd: the short id, the cover and the capabilities ticked; the invitation answered shown once, with the sentence that no email is sent
R2 the row acts send their owners' arguments: membercaps, memberset, adminendorse, adminremove (with its reason), expertiseconfirm, invitewithdraw
R2 joining through the website: websitekeycreate and joinlinkenable with a daily cap; the key and the link shown once
R2 a refusal is drawn beside its act and nothing else changes; R8 nothing is drawn as done before the answer
R12 each row's name is the member's reference (cs.ref member, opening members/<id>), its panel opened by its own control
R23 a member's row offers Make a reset link (passwordresetlink), the link shown once with the sentence that no email is sent
R23 More for administrators links group, places and recovery; a member's row offers no signing-key act of its own (R55 draws them in the keys section)
R55 the keys section lists a row for each active member and the founder: who registered each active key and when, the founder named as R51 names her, and no key says so
R55 Withdraw is offered on another member's active key and never on the viewer's own (she revokes it on account); it sends signerset revoked for that key
R55 a withdrawn key reads who withdrew it and when, that it does not sign, and offers Reactivate: signerset active; never for a member who has left
R55 a registered_by or status_by of `not recorded`, or a null status_at, is never drawn as a person or a day: the unrecorded lines
R55 Register a key for this member (signeradd): the pasted line is split into keyB64 and comment, with memberId; a line not of that shape, a private key or an empty line sends nothing
R55 control: a member who does not administer is drawn none of it and reads no signerlist; a failed read is drawn failed, never as no keys
R56 with adminarith answering the live row for 4 administrators the sentence carries 3 and 4; at 3 and above it says how many votes it takes
R56 control: one administrator reads that none can be removed by vote; a roster that lists every counted administrator draws no reconcile fold; more counted than listed draws it with the difference
R29 Administrators and Active members count the roster as listed, the founder's row once among them (R51)
R29 control: a member with no expertise shows no Expertise, and an empty cell draws nothing
R35, R51 a claimed team with no founder handle held draws her row from the roster, handle null: Active members 2, Administrators 1 with one other member; never named by admin
R35 control: with her handle held her row draws it, in her own session and wherever the roster answers it
R56 the scale table: a row for each count of administrators from adminarith's table, the live row marked (now) and aria-current; one administrator reads not removable

R56 a removal under way is drawn from adminremovalsopen alone: who it waits for, how many of those who may vote have agreed, the one facing removal counted and not voting; none under way draws no block; a failed read is drawn failed
R63 a confirmed expertise offers Withdraw an expertise, its own act: expertisewithdraw sends memberId, label and the reason; an unconfirmed one still offers Confirm and no withdrawal (control)
R63 control: no withdrawal for an expertise already withdrawn, nor to a member who does not administer
R64 the signing-key chooser lists the founder, first, once the instance is claimed and she holds a handle; a roster without her row, or her with none, is unchanged (control)
R71 a member's name is a reference to their handle, not to the id they were invited under; opening that address opens that member's row

R72 choosing the grant that includes administering draws the confirmation and sends nothing; Go back sends nothing and unticks it; Make them an administrator sends the declared fields; a grant without administering sends at once (control)

R2 C89: inviting a third administrator is a proposal the plane records: it is drawn as done (not as a refusal) with who must still endorse, the roster is read again and shows the proposed member; control: another refusal is still a refusal, and an invitation that is not for an administrator is unchanged

R2 C89: endorsing a proposed administrator while others must still endorse is done, with who must still endorse by handle, and the roster is read again; control: a real refusal of the act is still a refusal
R56 C90: the vote to remove an administrator is not drawn where the plane cannot carry it (two administrators); with three, or with the count unread, it is (control)
R55 R56 C94: a key's registrar and a removal's voters are named by memberName: a member the roster does not hold or who has no handle by the fallback word, never an id
R6 reads the member's own notes; states who can see them (protected words); each note's acts in its panel
R6 notewrite, noterevise and notedelete send their owner's arguments (hypotheses R11–R13)
R6 noteturn, as the owner's shape names: into a hunch {inquiry, kind, about}, or into an observation or question already made
R6 writinghelp under the note's field only while the assistant is reachable; its draft in the field labeled "Draft · the assistant's, asked by <handle>", kept only by the member's own act
R11 a writinghelp draft whose answer carries untested is drawn with ai.label.untested beside its Draft label; one without it carries none
R7 the court sentence, in membership R108's words, once: the first time this member keeps a note while the group tells members
R15 security: an administrator's screen; any other member is told only that it is administrators', and nothing is read
R15 the level for the period chosen, by kind against its usual, naming no address, country, role or member
R15 what is built in is said only as part_scanner and part_safe_view answer it
R15 securitytooladd asks only the entry's config by its labels, its credentials in the body only, confirms the vendor's keeping, sends the handling's digest; then tests it and says whether it is on
R15 securitytooltest and securitytoolremove from the tool's row panel; a refusal in file-safety's words
R62 security reads whose server from data: handling.on_own, never the recipient's words
R43 an ordinary period leads with one sentence under its mark, the period named by its first and last day, the counts folded, and the catalogue of kinds only in the 'Add another checker' fold
R43 a raised or high period leads with what happened (a hard try at signing in) and that it was refused
R43 a period may end today: to is no later than the end of the present hour; the opening period asked again lands; a period ending yesterday sends the next midnight as before
R43 a start after the end sends nothing and draws the refusal in a fold, open, that is drawn only then; a member who does not administer reads only that the screen is administrators'
R15 a tool in use is named by its provider's display name (vendor and product from the catalogue), never by its slug

R74 each credential field of a provider is labelled by its word (file-scanner.credential.<field>), never its raw name; the field sent stays the catalogue's; a field outside the four keeps its own name
R77 a scanner that holds no signatures is said so by the keys scanstatus answers, with the day and the reason; absent, nothing is drawn (control)

R15, R77 C83: files are said to be checked only while signatures are held; a scanner with none draws that state with its date and reason and no checked sentence; control: signatures held draw the sentence
R15, R77 C83: the administrator's step is said once in each state of a scanner with no signatures; where no reason line is drawn it is drawn on its own; the other states draw none (control)
R15 C84: Security draws a button that checks for new signatures now, sends scanmirror once, draws that the run goes on, and reads the scanner's state again

R15 C84: a run asked for inside the minimum gap, or with no scanner bound, is refused beside the button in file-safety's own words; no button where no scanner is built in, and none to a member who does not administer (control)
R16 translations: the group's languages each open their words; translations and interfacewords read for the chosen language
R16 each word a row: its English, meaning note, state, its text with who adopted it, and whether its English changed
R16 the panel: translationadopt (typed, or a stored draft kept as drafted), translationconfirm (an awaiting protected word), translationrevert (an administrator's)

R16 translationdraft: the picked words' drafts and an administrator's reading of an awaiting protected word go to the door while the assistant is reachable; the door's refusal is drawn in its words, and nothing is drafted, adopted or confirmed
R16 translationgrant: an administrator grants or revokes a named member's right for the language
R31 translations: every language is listed by its name in the member's language and never as a tag; the group's source English is not offered; a row shows its English and meaning, never its key
R31 translations: a member who is not granted sees the refusal's own words alone, no section about the words
R37 a group with no language beside English draws screens-settings' languages.none by key; no language is offered, nor a choice of one; a failed read is drawn failed

R1 the roster: each member's handle, cover (to an administrator), role, capabilities and status; no "formerly" (DEC-197)
R47 to a member who does not administer, Members is a table of members, what each may do and their expertise, with who changes it; no key or keep-away section
R1 the one-administrator note while the step is not met, as setup-page R16 states it; nothing once met
R1 each read drawn in its state: still loading, empty, could not read (never as empty), or its data
R2 every registry act is drawn for an administrator where it applies, each row's acts in its own panel; none to a member who does not administer
R2 memberadd: the short id, the cover and the capabilities ticked; the invitation answered shown once, with the sentence that no email is sent
R2 the row acts send their owners' arguments: membercaps, memberset, adminendorse, adminremove (with its reason), expertiseconfirm, invitewithdraw
R2 joining through the website: websitekeycreate and joinlinkenable with a daily cap; the key and the link shown once
R2 a refusal is drawn beside its act and nothing else changes; R8 nothing is drawn as done before the answer
R12 each row's name is the member's reference (cs.ref member, opening members/<id>), its panel opened by its own control
R23 a member's row offers Make a reset link (passwordresetlink), the link shown once with the sentence that no email is sent

R3 the handle drawn fixed in DEC-197's words; no handlechange act, and no handle.changeable, handle.formerly or handle.refused.* drawn

R3 the explanation level: infolevelset sent through the shell's setting, kept on the device (interface-shell R17)
R3, R31 memberlanguageset sends the tag the member chose by name, or null to follow the device; no tag is drawn or typed
R3 setpassword: current and new, the new typed twice alike, sent only when alike (setup-page R3's rule)
R3 expertisedeclare; signerrevokeown for the member's own key
R3 a member without a capability an act needs is not offered it; the founder's session is
R12 account draws the appearance control by cs.appearance(), never the shell's buttons of its own
R21 Sign out on this device (signout) and Sign out everywhere (signouteverywhere), each then drawing front's signed-out state (cs.signedOut, interface-shell R46)

R57 (1) Make your signing key: the tick, the optional passphrase field (a password field), and the act labelled for the account; the passphrase and the tick are the kit's arguments, the file deferred

R57 (2) after it is made: its tail and day, the public line as data, Copy the public line, and Save the key file only for a key that made a file (never for one kept on the device); nothing of it in any request or storage

R57 (3) a key an administrator registered for the member reads "registered for you by <who>, an administrator, on <date>" with the note that only she can sign with it, beside Revoke; one she made herself is drawn as before
R42 account draws the Sounds choice (off by default) beside Language and Appearance, and sends nothing when it is changed; no sentence is drawn twice
R57 (1), (2) a key made with a typed passphrase opens no dialog, sends keyB64, and offers Save the key file from page memory; the passphrase and the file are in no request or storage

R67 control: a member the pairings do not hold (the founder, who has no cover) is drawn no such section; a failed read is drawn failed, never as a choice

R22 R57 C51: the key section offers the member's key file, and a file chosen is read by the kit, handed to the signer (the dialog asks only the passphrase) and the key it holds is the one registered; nothing of the file is stored or sent

R6 reads the member's own notes; states who can see them (protected words); each note's acts in its panel
R6 notewrite, noterevise and notedelete send their owner's arguments (hypotheses R11–R13)
R6 noteturn, as the owner's shape names: into a hunch {inquiry, kind, about}, or into an observation or question already made
R6 writinghelp under the note's field only while the assistant is reachable; its draft in the field labeled "Draft · the assistant's, asked by <handle>", kept only by the member's own act
R11 a writinghelp draft whose answer carries untested is drawn with ai.label.untested beside its Draft label; one without it carries none
R7 the court sentence, in membership R108's words, once: the first time this member keeps a note while the group tells members
R17 settings: "Yours" then, to a session that administers, "The group's", each a reference to its screen; a member is drawn only their own
R32 settings draws its sections as the design's link list: each its icon and its screen's name as the reference, its purpose beneath, the two never run together
R20 recovery: the member's own codes (recoverycodesstate); new codes shown once, saying first that issuing again spends the earlier ones
R20 recovery: to an administrator, adminrecoverystep's note while not met; nothing once met, and a step that did not answer is never drawn as not met
R42 recovery draws screen.recovery.onlyyou once, above the act that issues new codes

R18 group: groupnameset, groupdomainset, grouplanguagesset, courtnoticeset, hostingaccessset and strengthbarset (reasoned) send their owners' arguments
R18 group: grouplogoset sends the chosen PNG or JPEG's own bytes as the body with its type, nothing in the address; another type sends nothing
R31 group: every language is shown by its name in the member's language and ticked by name; a tag such as en-US is never shown or typed
R33, R75 group: a hosting account recorded at setup or by the system is set at setup or by the system (its own words), never a credential's name
R28 group: a section that holds nothing is not drawn, and nothing says there is none
R40 the statement is drawn with who set it and when, or that none is declared; a member reads it and is drawn no act
R40 declaredstakeset saves the statement; an emptied field clears it (null); STAKE_MALFORMED and NOT_AN_ADMIN are drawn by their words
R40 writinghelp under the field only while the assistant is reachable; its draft in the field, labeled, untested where the answer says so, kept only by the administrator's own save
R44 group: the hosting account and the bar carry their card on the heading; each section opens with its sentence; the card is not said again in the body
R45 the zone that governs is shown by its name, never its id: the design's seven by label.timezones.*, any other by its generic name and its city
R45 a correction sends factconfirm with act correct, the zone, how and source on the team's own path (a place's zone is only the default); then the zone is read again and named as saved
R45 none held: a fold, the choice below it, no UTC; a member who does not administer is drawn no correction
R45 D-B1 no place chosen: the zone is stated from the screen on the team's own path, the owner takes it, and the screen then names it as the team's
R52 a value not set by a member is said as set at setup or by the system, never by a credential's name; a value set by a member is not
R52 after groupnameset answers, the new name is said (screen.group.name.saved); the same name says nothing changed, in a fold open whenever drawn

R66 the founder is drawn the copy of the record (a field for her words, Take a copy of the record, that it cannot be undone) and the list of copies; the list shows each copy's time, its counts and her words, newest first
R66 control: an administrator who is not the founder is drawn the list and no act to take a copy, and who can; a member is drawn none of it; a refusal is drawn in the design's words
R69 group draws the team's website file as instance-setup answers it (well_known), a save and a copy of it, and the steps to place it; the file follows the answer, the page builds none
R69 control: an answer with no file draws the steps without one; no claim draws no fold; a member reads the file as well, and is offered no act; groupdomainset refused draws the design's words
R75 the hosting account recorded at setup or by Civicsmith itself says so, in its own words; one a member recorded keeps today's (control)

R66 C85: Take a copy of the record sends her words as the query's note, offers the answer (the manifest) as a download, and labels its counts; the list is read again; control: no words sends no note, a note in the body is no request
R18 C86: the latest check of the website draws when it was made and the plane's own verdict (file not found, 404), read again after Verify the website; control: a verified check draws no verdict line

R75 C88: the hosting account is not said to be recorded at setup when a founder recorded it later; it is recorded on its date by the member named, the founder named by memberName; a bootstrap recorder and a machine keep their words
R40 R75 C94: who set the stake and who recorded the hosting account are named by memberName: the handle where it differs from the id, the fallback word where the member has none, never an id
R66 C85: each count of a copy in the list is drawn with its label (records, files, tables), one or many, a zero as any other; the copy just taken says its tables after a comma

R65 choosing a project and asking for its lens sends scope and scopeId and draws the team's statements then the project's; a project with nothing in force says so and what a case published now says, never an empty lens
R65 the folds: a project statement that met a locked one, and a set adopted while only offered, each only when the owner says so

R65 writing a set: the bundle promote takes (a bias bundle offered), the subject resolved from its name, the guard accepts it; a name the record does not know is refused in place; then the saved set can be adopted for the team or a project with the member's reason

R65 the team's earlier offered sets are listed and adoptable without writing them again: the cursor is followed, the set just saved comes first, a set of another type or already adopted is not listed, an empty answer draws no list
R65 a refusal is drawn by the owner's words beside the act, and nothing else changes; a set with no name or no reason is not sent

R65 drafting from an outside policy: biasinhale sends the policy, where it comes from and when; the proposals are marked not yet the member's, a bar and a verdict are left out with the design's words; nothing is saved until she starts a set, which promotes a draft once each has a subject and a reason

R65 work made under an earlier lens: the address names the work, its record is read, a member settles it with her own reason (1 to 4,000 characters), the assistant cannot; a settled one shows its settlement and offers no settling; unknown work draws nothing
R65 control: a request that carries a field its owner does not declare is refused by the guard (promote's, biasadopt's, biasinhale's and biasdebtresolve's bodies are accepted)
R65 C87: Propose statements from it with the policy empty, and Save the set with a required box empty, send nothing and name the box; filled, they send (control)
R65 C94: who adopted a set and who settled a debt are named by memberName: the handle where it differs from the id, the fallback word where the member has none, never an id

outside.waitsOn: store-request: the item in its interface files
tests: R61 reads the rules and the roster; Waiting for a second member lists each drafted rule: what it is for, who drafted it and when, its source as a reference opening the document, its trigger, citation and the day it takes effect
R61 a rule the viewer drafted is told so and has no confirm act; every other waiting rule has one (R61: Drafted by you)

tests: R61 reads the rules and the roster; Waiting for a second member lists each drafted rule: what it is for, who drafted it and when, its source as a reference opening the document, its trigger, citation and the day it takes effect
R61 a rule the viewer drafted is told so and has no confirm act; every other waiting rule has one (R61: Drafted by you)
R61 Confirm this rule: a tier 1 rule asks no statement; a tier 2, 3 or unknown tier asks the confirmer's own, required before the act is sent, kept with the confirmation alone
R61 Rules in force: each confirmed rule with who drafted and confirmed it and that it applies, and Withdraw this rule, with a reason (rulewithdraw); a rule not yet in effect is not said to apply
R61 control: the assistant's note is drawn; a failed read is drawn failed, never as no rules; a read with no rules draws no section

R61 the draft form draws the design's fields: the kinds of action by their own names (claim first), the choices by their words, the document among the captures held, and writing help only while the assistant is reachable and only under What it says
R61 ruledraft for a deadline sends the section, the entry built from the fields (the stored rule derived from the one name), the source with the passage's place, and the reason
